mapper.select: SELECT id, ds_id, feedback_id, review_task_id, suggestion_no, wiki_space, page_path, page_title, page_content, page_type, status, remote_task_id, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time FROM fb_wiki_writeback WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY retry_count ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, ds_id, feedback_id, review_task_id, suggestion_no, wiki_space, page_path, page_title, page_content, page_type, status, remote_task_id, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time FROM fb_wiki_writeback WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND remote_task_id IS NOT NULL AND remote_task_id != '' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT status AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fb_wiki_writeback WHERE ds_id = #{dsId} GROUP BY status

SELECT id, ds_id, feedback_id, review_task_id, suggestion_no, wiki_space, page_path, page_title, page_content, page_type, status, remote_task_id, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time FROM fb_wiki_writeback WHERE ds_id = #{dsId} AND feedback_id = #{feedbackId} ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 1
